Persisted results are protected, but preparation is not exclusive — implement the required locked sweep claim and exclusive finalisation claim.

findings.source_line: P3 lib/voice-notes/transcription-reconcile.ts:207 — Sweep selects 'processing' rows without FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED (plan and review focus 3); a concurrent poll and cron tick both query Google and run the spelling pass, and only the compare-and-set keeps the row correct (proven on real pg). Not user-facing. Fix: claim with SKIP LOCKED in a short transaction before the Google call, or record that the compare-and-set is the chosen guard.

findings.source_line: P2 lib/utils/google-speech.ts:219 — DR-08, H-U0: a practitioner finishing a three-minute note on an iPad during Google unavailability can exceed Cloud Run’s 300-second deadline. The inherited short path starts batch recognition without timeout options; its 240-second timer starts only after that RPC returns. Reproduced still pending after 300001 ms, leaving a pending recording outside reconciliation — enforce an overall speech deadline below 300 seconds, including startup, inline recognition and SDK retries.
findings.clinic_scenario: A practitioner on the clinic iPad stops a three-minute note while Google Speech is down or very slow; the upload request is killed at 300 s and the row stays 'pending'.
findings.ordinary_use: none: needs a Google outage that stalls the batchRecognize start RPC; no ordinary user action triggers it
findings.follow_up: AestheticcNext-4rr06: Short voice-note path: bound the whole sync transcription (batchRecognize start + wait) below Cloud Run's 300 s
findings.reason: Pre-existing, and the branch left it exactly the same. origin/main lib/utils/google-speech.ts:216 awaits client.batchRecognize({recognizer, config, files, recognitionOutputConfig}) with no call options; the 240 s LONG_RUNNING_TIMEOUT_MS wraps only operation.promise(). At the tip, line 219 calls the new shared builder startBatchRecognition(uri, config) (lib/utils/google-speech-batch.ts:95), which issues the identical request on the same getSpeechClient() singleton with callOptions undefined: no timeout added, none removed, retry budget unchanged. The branch actually narrows exposure: on main every note length went through this sync path; at the tip only notes of 270 s or less do, long notes use the bounded background start (START_TIMEOUT_MS 60 s, raced and passed as the gax timeout). Under scope_lock the branch did not cause it, so it is a follow-up (filed AestheticcNext-4rr06, discovered-from 9kwlw, qa-followup) and cannot add a round. Opus h2h at the same tip read this short path as unchanged and raised nothing.
